title: RBL BANK Credit Card offer — Domestic Flights — Flat INR 1,800 off for two passengers for a round trip.
usageLimit: The offer can be availed once per card, per category, per month during the offer period.
terms: Category: Domestic Flights. Flat INR 1,800 off for two passengers for a round trip.
Offer days and validity: Everyday, from 1 September to 30 September 2026.
Applicable on: RBL BANK Credit Card
The offer is valid on payment made with RBL BANK Credit Cards only.
Enter the promo code ‘YATRARBL’.
The offer can be availed everyday, between 1 September and 30 September 2026.
The offer can be availed on the Yatra website and the Yatra app.
The offer can be availed once per card, per category, per month during the offer period.
